selection: Calibration-only thresholds and unchanged binary screens. Add a prespecified >=80% recall guard for each required validation family with >=25 connections. Prefer candidates passing both binary and family screens, then validation F1/recall/precision/lower FPR/smaller artifact/stable ID. Twelve candidates, dummy and two identical one-thread repeats. No external test or new search.
scope: Experimental accepted-label capture/time comparison only; all warm-up/excluded rows retained, only accepted labels fit. No metadata/endpoint identities enter model inputs. Device independence and DDoS label coverage remain unresolved. Research models may be exported privately under the separate encrypted-transfer protocol; no public weights or raw/derived real rows.
